title: Exo Hub
features: Exo Hub is a lightweight utility that gives you two simple tools: a camera noclip mode so your view can pass through walls without changing your character, and a rising platform that follows under your feet like an elevator. The design is clean and modern with neon highlights and rounded corners, built to stay out of the way while still being easy to use
script:
local function get(url)
    if syn and syn.request then
        return syn.request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
    elseif http_request then
        return http_request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
    elseif request then
        return request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
    elseif game and game.HttpGet then
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    else
        error("No HTTP request function found")
    end
end
